h1_carry.capital_per_notional: 1 (TSE spot bought with cash) + 1/leverage (isolated perp margin)
h1_carry.cost_events: one full round trip at open+close; a perp round trip per TSE split (AdjFactor != 1) and per liquidation
h1_carry.leverage_source: backtests/japan_earnings_risk.py: largest of 1.5/2/3/4x whose liquidation room is >= 1.25 x the worst rise between closes (TSE since 2016-10 or listing, and xyz)
h1_carry.liquidation: the perp's highest 15m high (else 1h) between two daily closes rises >= 1/L - 0.05 over the earlier close; that day the margin is lost: P&L = spot USD return - 1/L - perp round trip, and the short is reopened at the close with margin reset to 1/L
h1_carry.question: Does the funding received by shorting xyz Japanese stock perps against TSE spot beat the BTC/ETH funding capture after costs, without liquidation, over one year?

secondary_descriptive.funding_exit_rule: flat after a close where the trailing 10 TSE days' funding sum is negative, back in when it is >= 0; each switch pays half a round trip

h1_carry.valuation: 15:30 JST (06:30 UTC) each TSE day: perp = 15m open at 06:30 UTC (else 06:00 hourly close), fair = TSE raw close / xyz:JPY; daily P&L per notional = -d(basis) + funding received

verdicts.insufficient_data: valid days below the minimum share for an instrument
verdicts.not_confirmed: no liquidation and coverage ok, but return or significance fails
verdicts.rejected_for_risk: a liquidation at the registered leverage

h1_carry.weights: equal capital across instruments; the day's portfolio return averages the instruments measured

gap_window.use: descriptive only: decided after the 2026-08-01 research boundary, computed only after registration, never pooled

h2_short_ratio.power_note: about 104 weeks: roughly 60% power for a weekly correlation of 0.2 and 25% for 0.1
h2_short_ratio.question: Does the J-Quants short-selling share (S3) predict the next-week Nikkei 225 out of sample?
